_doc: Closes the cardinality-cliff campaign: (a) measure the STACKED ideal config (split-lane + syncfs + 1GiB size-trigger checkpoint [PR #4704] + exclusive pinned cores [STATIC_CPU=1 + GUARANTEED=1]) which was previously measured only separately (size-1g 303k @100k on shared cores; bound-3s 328k @100k with 3s timer; stacked projection ~360k); (b) extreme-cardinality check at 500k and 1M streams — the mechanisms that caused the old cliff are gone, this verifies no NEW mechanism appears (candidates: 1 fd per live stream vs the container nofile limit ~1M, DashMap/meta working set, ext4 dir with 1M files, tails-map rewrite cost). An EMFILE/collapse at 1M is itself a finding, not a broken run. Single arm. 500k/1M use a single p8 rung (each rung recreates all streams after the server reset — setup dominates; BARRIER_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600 host-side and DS_BENCH_BARRIER_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600 pod-side cover the long creation phase, setup_concurrency 32). Requires STATIC_CPU=1 SPLITLANE=1 GUARANTEED=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1 IMG_SERVER=...:sizetrigger BARRIER_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600.
